catalogue_name: Sukuu Search Ghana National Metadata Catalogue
scope_statement: Country-wide Ghana metadata and discovery infrastructure for businesses, organisations, services, institutions, places and other entities. Schools are the first production vertical, not the platform boundary.

datasets.name: Ghana Schools Directory
datasets.description: Deployed school discovery surface with searchable directory records, canonical school pages and approximate locality coordinates.

datasets.name: Ghana Administrative Geography
datasets.description: Canonical shared geography layer: Ghana, 16 regions and the integrated 261-district ADM2 layer.

datasets.name: Accredited Tertiary Institutions
datasets.description: GTEC institution-level accreditation metadata materialized from all published category listing pages with authority institutionId and provenance.
datasets.data_quality_note: GTEC public surfaces observed on 10 Sep 2026 expose differing aggregate institution counts; the register snapshot, not a headline count, will be authoritative.

datasets.name: Accredited Tertiary Programmes
datasets.description: GTEC programme accreditation occurrences materialized from institution programme registers.

datasets.name: Accredited TVET Providers & Programmes
datasets.description: Complete numbered CTVET provider register plus programme, NTVETQF level, qualification and dated accreditation occurrences.

datasets.name: Approved Learning Resources
datasets.description: NaCCA-approved textbooks and supplementary instructional resources linked to subject, grade/level, publisher and approval metadata.

observations.source_note: Sum of the subject totals in NaCCA December 2024 approved-resource publication.
Sum of NaCCA supplementary category totals in the December 2024 publication.

datasets.name: Scholarships & Education Opportunities
datasets.description: Time-sensitive official scholarship notices, eligibility and deadlines.

datasets.name: Public Libraries
datasets.description: Branch locations and public learning-service metadata for national discovery.

datasets.name: Education Administration Offices
datasets.description: Regional and district education administration metadata, contacts and jurisdictional relationships.

datasets.name: Licensed Health Facilities
datasets.description: National licensed health-facility metadata with regulator provenance and geography.

datasets.name: Ambulance & Emergency Response
datasets.description: National emergency-response service and station metadata with operational geography modelled separately where required.

datasets.name: Police & Public Safety Services
datasets.description: National police and public-safety service metadata; police operational hierarchies remain separate from MMDA geography.

datasets.name: National Statistical Indicators
datasets.description: Population, demographic, education and other official indicators joined only when statistical geography and vintage are explicit.

datasets.name: Digital Address Reference
datasets.description: Potential GhanaPostGPS reference layer for verified entity locations, subject to authorized integration and provenance controls.

datasets.name: Regulated Financial & Payment Services
datasets.description: Regulated financial and payment-service metadata from authoritative registers for general discovery and domain-specific integrations.
